title: Development Economics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the increase in the total amount of the goods and services (output) produced in an economy over time."
Economic growth as stated is the increase in the total amount of the goods and services (output) produced in an economy over time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the economy's average level of human capital."
The variable H is the economy's average level of human capital.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key recipe for economic development and a country that is starved of it is trapped in its own poverty hence the saying a country is poor because it is poor."
Capital is a key recipe for economic development and a country that is starved of it is trapped in its own poverty hence the saying a country is poor because it is poor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the long-lasting changes in the climate system which is caused by human activities or by natural climate variability (Ahuja, 2016)."
Climate change is the long-lasting changes in the climate system which is caused by human activities or by natural climate variability (Ahuja, 2016).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that a high percentage of the population are in dependent ages, 0-14, leading to the diversion of resources to food, shelter, and education for a large nonworking population."
High fertility means that a high percentage of the population are in dependent ages, 0-14, leading to the diversion of resources to food, shelter, and education for a large nonworking population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means more productive workers, and a large overall population increases the potential size of domestic markets."
A larger labor force means more productive workers, and a large overall population increases the potential size of domestic markets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long-term rise in the capacity to supply increasingly diverse economic goods to its population."
Economic growth is a long-term rise in the capacity to supply increasingly diverse economic goods to its population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to laws requiring a foreign exchange earner from export to sell the foreign exchange to a country agency."
Exchange control refers to laws requiring a foreign exchange earner from export to sell the foreign exchange to a country agency.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine if a country is developed or underdeveloped."
The HDI is used to determine if a country is developed or underdeveloped.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sustainable increase in the total outputs of goods and services produced in an economy accompanied by desirable institutional and social changes."
Economic development is the sustainable increase in the total outputs of goods and services produced in an economy accompanied by desirable institutional and social changes.
fib: ______ is the increase in the stock of real capital in an economy (Ahuja, 2016).
Capital formation
Capital formation is the increase in the stock of real capital in an economy (Ahuja, 2016).
______ is a commitment to social progress, economic growth and environmental balance which are often referred to as the 3 pillars of stainable development.
Sustainable development
Sustainable development is a commitment to social progress, economic growth and environmental balance which are often referred to as the 3 pillars of stainable development.
______ is an economic growth model explaining the long-run economic growth within the neoclassical economies.
Solow-Swan model
The Solow-Swan model is an economic growth model explaining the long-run economic growth within the neoclassical economies.
______ is an economy with weak economic and development base.
underdeveloped economy
An underdeveloped economy is an economy with weak economic and development base.
______ is a reflection of low productivity which is mainly caused by insufficient capital.
low real income
The low real income is a reflection of low productivity which is mainly caused by insufficient capital.
______ is the coexistence of an advanced imported capitalist system and an indigenous pre-capitalist backward system.
Domestic dualism
Domestic dualism is the coexistence of an advanced imported capitalist system and an indigenous pre-capitalist backward system.
______ is a broad measure of aggregate economic activity which can be calculated using three different approaches.
Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
Gross Domestic Product
GDP
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a broad measure of aggregate economic activity which can be calculated using three different approaches.
______ is a model of structural change because it outlines the development from a traditional economy to an industrialized one.
Lewis model
The Lewis model is a model of structural change because it outlines the development from a traditional economy to an industrialized one.
______ is a trade strategy in which there is bias of incentive towards production of import substitutes (Metu et al., 2018).
Export promotion strategy
Export promotion strategy is a trade strategy in which there is bias of incentive towards production of import substitutes (Metu et al., 2018).
______ is the increased application of new scientific knowledge in the form of inventions and innovations with regard to both physical and human capital.
Technological progress
Technological progress is the increased application of new scientific knowledge in the form of inventions and innovations with regard to both physical and human capital.
